issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

enabled.description: Whether text streaming to the UI should be enabled or disabled.

streamingFrequencyMs.description: The frequency in milliseconds at which the UI should check for new stream chunks.

dbStreamingIntervalSeconds.description: The interval in seconds between writes of the streaming data to the database

typewriterKeyDelayInProgress.description:
The amount of delay in milliseconds between each render when chunks are still being received.
A lower delay means there is less time between each render, but could lead to pauses in the stream,
since the the UI would spend more time waiting on the next stream chunk to be returned.

typewriterKeyDelayFinished.description: The amount of delay in milliseconds between each render when all chunks have been received.

contextSize.description:
The number of characters used to establish context for sentence boundary detection while stream chunking.
Larger context improves sentence detection accuracy.

minimumSentenceLength.description:
The minimum number of characters a returned sentence chunk must have.
Shorter sentences are concatenated with the following sentence.

strategy.description: The strategy for streaming text to the UI.

title: Configuration type for the text streaming feature.
name: Genai.Streaming.Config
